cards.title: Why a child saying 'Na-na, na-na-na!' so annoying?
cards.body: Readers share their perspectives on why repetitive, taunting behavior from children can be so irritating to adults. This long-running series explores everyday parenting puzzles through reader insights.

cards.title: Partner's conduct at sons' football matches causing concern
cards.body: A parent seeks advice about their partner's inappropriate behavior during their sons' football games. An advice columnist suggests exploring the root causes of this anger before judging.

cards.title: Pediatrician: human connection matters more than AI fears
cards.body: A pediatrician argues that loss of human connection poses a greater threat to children than technology itself. Open communication between parents and children is the real solution to tech concerns.

cards.title: Making Halloween magical for your kids this year
cards.body: A parent reflects on ditching cynicism to create meaningful Halloween traditions and moments of magic with their children. Celebrating autumn traditions can strengthen family connection and wonder.

cards.title: Benefits of having an older sibling during adolescence
cards.body: Older siblings often influence younger siblings in ways parents cannot, serving as trusted role models and mentors. This relationship can be uniquely valuable during the teenage years.

cards.title: Your child didn't get a party invite—here's what to do
cards.body: Missing out on a peer's party can be sad for young children, but parents can help them navigate this common situation constructively. There are practical strategies to support your child's emotional response.

cards.title: Catherine launches nature learning project for children
cards.body: The Princess of Wales launches an initiative encouraging greater emphasis on children learning from nature. The project promotes children's emotional growth through outdoor engagement.
